messages:
maria_ml: seeing a sharp p99 spike on redwood-v1-large-quant starting ~06:12 UTC, correlated with GPU OOMs on node gpx-04. customers pinging about timeouts. stack: hosted inference, dedicated pool

sam_sre: can you paste the timeline and any error snippets? which API route?

maria_ml: route: /v1/generate-stream (default model mapping). spikes at 06:12:05, repeated every ~30s for ~10m. logs: 
```
2026-03-15T06:12:05Z ERROR runtime: allocation failed: OOM after 12288MB attempted
2026-03-15T06:12:05Z WARN runtime: fallback triggered to cpu-slow-worker
```

maria_ml: prometheus shows p99 latency jump from 220ms -> 1.6s, p95 ~620ms. token throughput okay though.

liam_runtime: checking GPU metrics now. initial look: memory usage climbs steadily, fragmentation high (~18%) and free_contiguous drops below 200MB before OOM. KV cache size for that model on gpx-04 grew to ~9.6GB (config target 8GB) — looks like per-session KV growth + long prefixes.

alex_infra: any recent changes to allocator or model rollout?

maria_ml: we rolled out v1.4.2 of runtime yesterday (small kernel tweak) but only to 20% canary. these errors are across nodes with older and new runtime.

sam_sre: repro steps request: can you share a small curl script that reproduces? need to run on staging/isolated node.

maria_ml: repro script (quick):
```
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate-stream \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-large-quant","input":"'$(head -c 3500 < /dev/urandom | base64)'"}' &
done
wait
```
This pushes many long-prefix requests, KV grows fast.

liam_runtime: noted. immediate mitigation options: 1) evict old session KV aggressively (TTL 60s) 2) throttle huge prefix lengths on gateway 3) enable allocator defrag pass (experimental) 4) restart affected pods to release fragmented GPU memory. Which do we want now?

sam_sre: short-term: restart affected pods (rolling) + throttle prefixes > 2048 tokens at the ingress for that model. mid-term: enable kv eviction TTL and fix allocator settings.

alex_infra: I'm for rolling restart; starting with canary 10% to avoid full outage. also enabling prefix throttle via envoy config change.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rolling restart redwood-runtime pool=dedicated-gpx-04 percent=10

maria_ml: after restarting first 10%: GPU free_contiguous went up, p99 for that subset returned to ~250ms. overall p99 still elevated because other nodes still saturated.

liam_runtime: telemetry query to check fragmentation:
```
sum by(node) (gpu_memory_fragmentation_ratio{pool="dedicated-gpx"})
```
Showing nodes gpx-04/gpx-07 with ratios 16-22%.

sam_sre: action items (short-term):
- throttle prefix length to 2048 for redwood-v1-large-quant via route rule (ingress)
- set KV cache TTL to 60s for that model in runtime config
- roll restart remaining 90% with 5m interval

maria_ml: added TTL to model config: 
```
model_configs.redwood-v1-large-quant.kv_cache: {
  max_size_bytes: 9000000000
  session_ttl_seconds: 60
  eviction_policy: LRU
}
```

liam_runtime: allocator tuning proposal for follow-up: reduce arena growth factor, enable on-demand coalescing and defrag pass every 5 minutes. config snippet: 
```
allocator: {
  arena_growth: 1.2
  defrag.interval_seconds: 300
  defrag.enabled: true
}
```

alex_infra: need runbook updates: add emergency knob to completely disable session KV for a model and fallback to cold KV on disk. We should also add an alert for free_contiguous < 256MB and fragmentation >15%.

maria_ml: customers already reported latency decrease after throttles + restarts. p99 trending down toward ~350ms after full roll.

sam_sre: follow-ups (owners):
- liam_runtime: implement allocator defrag + run pre-flight tests (ETA 48h)
- alex_infra: create alert & add knob to disable kv sessions (ETA 24h)
- maria_ml: track customer tickets and confirm regressions resolved (ETA ongoing)

liam_runtime: started run of the defrag branch in staging now. will run memory fragmentation regression test (script uses prefix churn + mixed seq lengths).

observability-bot: alert cleared: GPU_OOM_rate on pool dedicated-gpx fell below threshold (1m avg).

maria_ml: summary for support thread: immediate mitigations applied: prefix throttle, KV TTL 60s, rolling restarts. Medium-term: allocator defrag + eviction policies + alerting. We'll keep customers posted.

sam_sre: closing loop: please paste final metrics in #incidents once p99 stable for 24h and link support tickets. thx :thumbsup:"
